string-array.name: about_rows
string-array.item: Purpose: fast downloads and complete remote device control
Platform: Android phones, TV boxes & STBs (Android 5+)
Remote web: manage downloads, files and videos from a browser
Security: PIN protection, signed updates and local-first access
Performance: lightweight build optimized for low-memory devices
Storage: download manager, file manager and video gallery
Transparency: sideloaded apps may trigger a Play Protect warning
